ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a fly life cycle with arrows connecting four labeled stages. Letter A is next to an adult fly at the bottom. Letter B is next to a pale worm-like larva at the top. Letter C is next to a dark oval pupa on the right. Letter D is next to a cluster of small pale elongated grains on the left. Reasoning: In a fly life cycle, the stages are egg, larva, pupa, and adult. The small clustered grains at label D match the egg stage.
